plainText:
Several boxed sets have been released by VIZ Media collecting volumes of various Pokémon manga. They are generally released upon completion of a series or story arc. As an incentive for purchasing the boxed sets, they often contain special bonuses not included with the individual volume releases, generally collectable posters.

==Pokémon Adventures==

The first Pokémon Adventures boxed set was released on August 7, 2012. While it is titled the "Red & Blue Box Set", it actually contains through , covering both the and . A special poster was included in the box. The ISBN for this boxed set is ISBN 9781421550060.

===Germany===
====Red, Green & Blue / Yellow arcs====
To coincide with the twenty-fifth anniversary celebration of the Pokémon franchise, publisher Panini Comics reissued the and of the manga in one boxed set, consisting of three omnibus volumes, on August 31, 2021. Included with the books were seven postcards with the original Japanese cover illustrations of the seven adapted volumes. The release itself is limited to 2500 copies. The ISBN for this boxed set is ISBN 978-3-7416-2420-9. 

 

====Black & White arc====
On November 21, 2023, Panini released a limited-edition boxed set of the . It consists of three omnibus volumes and includes nine postcards with the original Japanese cover illustrations of the adapted volumes. The release itself is limited to 1111 copies. The ISBN for this set is 978-3-7416-3487-1. 

 

====X & Y arc====
On October 25, 2022, Panini released a limited-edition boxed set of the . It consists of three omnibus volumes and includes six postcards with the original Japanese cover illustrations of the adapted mini-volumes. The release itself is limited to 2500 copies. The ISBN for this set is 978-3-7416-3102-3. 

 

====Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc====
On March 22, 2022, Panini released a new limited-edition boxed set, this time for the . The ISBN for this set is 978-3-7416-2723-1.

==Pokémon Pocket Comics==
===United States/Canada/United Kingdom/Australia===
Two Pokémon 4Koma volumes, Pokémon Pocket Comics: Black & White and Pokémon Pocket Comics: Legendary Pokémon, were released in a boxed set by VIZ Media on October 4, 2016. The set is simply titled "Pokémon Pocket Comics Box Set: Black & White/Legendary Pokémon". The ISBN for this boxed set is ISBN 9781421589640.

 

==Pokémon Horizon==
===Vietnam===

==Welcome! Pokémon Café==
===Mainland China===

Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode was released on June 30, 2025 by Beijing Science and Technology Publishing Co.,Ltd. The box also contains an acrylic fan and four acrylic cards. The ISBN for this boxed set is ISBN 9787571446512.
